summaryForNext: ANALYZE PASS (round 1; critic MiniMax-M3, judge k3, cross_model_check VERIFIED-DISTINCT; 0 CRITICAL, 7 WARNING, 8 SUGGESTION; post-PASS fixes are UNREVIEWED). 11 candidates, 3 build items. READING THE RECORDER OVERTURNED THREE ASSESSMENT CLAIMS: (1) the recorder never writes events.jsonl - it appends to .prometheus/session-log.md and writes receipts; only pk writes events.jsonl, so one-file-or-two DISSOLVES. (2) Hash portability is narrower than reported: hook replays compare eventIdentitySha256 (8 fields, no float) which already MATCHES in Node; only eventSha256 differs, and exactly ONE field can be a float (elapsedHours, 0-1000). Re-observed on the golden receipt: naive DIFFERS, Python float token on that one field MATCHES. One receipt, integer-valued float only; reject elapsedHours in (0,1e-4). RFC 8785 libraries rejected - they MUST write 0. (3) The 1 s hook budget does not apply: upstream fires the recorder from KBD lifecycle hooks at 15 s. DECISIONS: thin NODE recorder in lib/karpathy + scripts/record-progress.mjs with pk as an OPTIONAL transport (a pk subcommand fails the degrade goal; pk has 0 releases). pk-present-LLM-absent -> receipt-driven retry (complete:false + degraded, retried on replay); learning queue DROPPED; no Python, no third daemon. Invocation = a CLI named by skill text at task/change/phase boundaries, NOT a 7th harness hook, so the exactly-six-ids scenario stands; this pack does not carry upstream kbd hooks.json, so the spec must name which skill files change. cargo-dist is REFERENCE ONLY for the next phase. CONTRACT THE SPEC MUST CARRY (all from the review, all verified): honour PK_BIN not just PATH; exit 0 for recorded/duplicate/DEGRADED, exit 2 for validation or I/O error; receipt written TWICE (complete:false before the memory write, final after); crash seams KPM_TEST_CRASH_BEFORE_MEMORY->74 and KPM_TEST_CRASH_AFTER_PK->75; queued is never EMITTED but must be READ - the golden receipt is complete:true + queued, replays as duplicate and is never retried (upstream behaviour; state it, do not imply eventual delivery); port list by name: event_from_hook, validate_event, canonical_validate, markdown_record, append_session_log, lock, memory_write, both hashes, write_receipt, receipt_path; inputs KBD_HOOK_NAME, KBD_TASK_CLASS, KBD_TASK_ELAPSED_HOURS, PK_BIN, KPM_PK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, git rev-parse, touched files. UNRESOLVED: (a) OPERATOR - OKF version: pk writes v0.1, index.md says 0.2, standing constraint is 0.2; recommend declaring 0.1 now. (b) SPEC - canonical_validate needs prometheus kbd status --json for EVERY event, so a missing prometheus CLI is either a degraded record or a refusal; undecided, and it was found by the judge, not by me. (c) spawnExecutable resolving pk.exe via PATHEXT is untested. (d) pk doctor failing on healthy Windows is a HYPOTHESIS from code reading, not observed - do not gate on it.
